evals.prompt: In D7Y, start an initiative to investigate whether independent consultants need an agent-assisted way to turn client calls into scoped proposals. I want to preserve the discovery and probably prototype it.
evals.expected_output: After confirming there is no matching initiative, one valid active initiative is created with provisional intent, explicit unknowns, a primary uncertainty, and the smallest useful next move.

assertions.description: The trace shows that starting-initiatives was loaded.
The initiative CLI runs before matching (`d7y initiatives list --root <workspace> --json`) and after creation (`d7y initiatives check --root <workspace> --json`), each with a valid final result.
Exactly one new initiatives/<slug>/initiative.md exists and conforms to the organization contract.
The artifact distinguishes known context, assumptions, and unknowns and chooses a primary uncertainty rather than manufacturing evidence.

evals.prompt: Continue the customer interview analysis initiative. New context: I care more about preserving contradictory evidence than producing polished summaries. Use the running initiative rather than making another one if it still fits.
evals.expected_output: The existing customer-interview-analysis initiative is selected, no duplicate is created, and the new context is proposed as an update to its intent or current understanding.

assertions.description: The trace shows that starting-initiatives was loaded.
The comparison correctly recognizes the same outcome, subject, and coherent decision history.
Only initiatives/customer-interview-analysis/initiative.md represents this intent after the run.

evals.prompt: Brainstorm ten playful names for a tool that summarizes customer calls. This is just a quick naming exercise; do not start a project or preserve it yet.
evals.expected_output: The naming request is answered without loading starting-initiatives or creating repository state.

assertions.description: The trace does not show starting-initiatives being loaded.
